Out of the maximum of 12 warps per scheduler, this workload allocates an average of 12.87 active warps per scheduler, but only an average of 0.30 warps were eligible per cycle. Eligible warps are the subset of active warps that are ready to issue their next instruction. Every cycle with no eligible warp results in no instruction being issued and the issue slot remains unused. To increase the number of eligible warps, avoid possible load imbalances due to highly different execution durations per warp.
